title: Montreal Distillery Tour and Spirit Tasting at Cirka
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the art of distilling at Québec's first grain-to-bottle distillery located along the historic Lachine Canal. This engaging tour invites you to explore the transformation of local grains and botanicals into award-winning spirits. Guided by passionate team members, you'll gain insights into the unique distillation process and sample a selection of their signature products including whisky, gin, vodka, and liqueurs. Enjoy a welcome cocktail before diving into tastings that showcase the essence of Montréal's spirit craftsmanship.

- Guided tour and tasting experience lasting approximately 1.5 hours
- Sample a variety of spirits including gin, vodka, and liqueurs
- Small group sizes ensure personalized and immersive interactions
